sloka: सा रामम् पर्णशालायाम् उपविष्टम् परंतपम् ।सीतया सह दुर्धर्षम् अब्रवीत् काम मोहिता ॥३-१८-१४॥
transliteration: sā rāmam parṇaśālāyām upaviṣṭam paraṁtapam ।sītayā saha durdharṣam abravīt kāma mohitā ॥3-18-14॥

translations.english: Deluded with passion, Surpanakha said to formidable Rama, the scorcher of foes, seated in the leafthatched hut along with Sita:
